7502.title: Scheduler history survives Claude session forks
7502.rootCauseOneLine: The real fork worker preserves CronCreate tool history and the bridge resumes the copied session; native scheduler restoration and duplicate firing remain unverified.
7502.proposedFix: First demonstrate native scheduler replay in isolated parent and child sessions, then prevent inherited executable schedules without removing conversation history or disabling new child tasks.
7502.caveats: Both clean runs prove transcript copying only. No authenticated Claude scheduler or timer tick was exercised; no failing behavioral regression exists, so no simple fix was attempted.
